settings.page.gap.title: Capabilities not connected yet
settings.page.general.subtitle: Update, default actions and code-signing trust for the ECL application.
settings.page.general.gap.startup.title: Startup behavior
settings.page.general.gap.startup.reason: Windows startup registration, the system tray and session restore are not implemented, so no switches are shown that would have no effect.
settings.page.general.gap.window.title: Window and close behavior
settings.page.general.gap.window.reason: Main-window close/minimize lifecycle wiring (ADR 0039) is not implemented.
settings.page.general.gap.update.title: Update check interval and discovered-update behavior
settings.page.general.gap.update.reason: The UI is not connected to the unified update flow (ADR 0051) for periodic checks and automatic downloads.
ECL has no ordinary task notification channel yet; switches would create false controls.
Ordinary action confirmation and result dialogs
A unified contract for ordinary-action confirmation and auto-closing success result dialogs is not implemented.
settings.general.codeSigning.title: ECL code-signing trust
settings.general.codeSigning.description: ECL uses a self-signed Authenticode certificate. Trusting imports only the leaf certificate with the fixed fingerprint into this machine's TrustedPeople store; it is not public-CA identity endorsement and never runs without confirmation.
settings.general.codeSigning.statusTrust: This machine trusts the ECL code-signing certificate.
settings.general.codeSigning.statusUntru: This machine does not trust the certificate yet; ECL and update Manifest verification keep working.
settings.general.codeSigning.notRead: Code-signing status has not been read yet.
settings.general.codeSigning.trustMessag:
This self-signed certificate is generated by ECL; it is not public-CA endorsement of the developer's real identity.

SHA-256 fingerprint:
{0}

After import, Windows will trust code signed by this certificate in TrustedPeople. This requires administrator rights. You may decline; ECL still runs and update Manifest verification is unaffected. Continue?
settings.general.codeSigning.revokeMessa: This removes the ECL self-signed code certificate from this machine's TrustedPeople store. Update Manifest verification is unaffected. Continue?
settings.general.codeSigning.error.unkno: Could not read the code-signing status.

The code-signing trust information is invalid.
The public certificate file was not found.

settings.page.interface.subtitle: Font, scaling, language and motion preferences. The ECL brand theme is fixed; there is no theme color or light mode.
settings.page.interface.gap.font.title: Interface font and text size
settings.page.interface.gap.font.reason: Bundled fonts exist, but the design system does not provide switchable font and size tiers yet.
settings.page.interface.gap.scale.title: Interface scaling
settings.page.interface.gap.scale.reason: App-level scaling and multi-DPI verification are not finished, so no slider is offered that could clip core controls.
settings.page.interface.gap.motion.title: Enable interface motion
settings.page.interface.gap.motion.reaso: Motion currently follows the Windows "reduce animation" preference; an in-app preference requires turning the motion policy into a configurable service.
settings.page.java.subtitle: Java runtime settings: search path and install source. Migrating the runtime inventory and priority order is not finished.
settings.page.java.gap.inventory.title: Runtime inventory and discovery
settings.page.java.gap.inventory.reason: Java discovery, inventory and verification state have not moved into Settings yet; the top-level Java entry stays for now so no capability is lost.
settings.page.java.gap.priority.title: Global priority order
settings.page.java.gap.priority.reason: The existing list uses the search path as a priority list and there is no separate user priority store; no ordering control is offered before that migration.
settings.page.java.gap.validation.title: Add, verify and invalid-path state
settings.page.java.gap.validation.reason: Per-runtime verification state and invalid paths are not presented yet; no available/verified marks are faked.
settings.page.java.gap.uninstall.title: Remove and uninstall
settings.page.java.gap.uninstall.reason: Ownership and safe-uninstall boundaries for ECL-managed runtimes are not connected; no button deletes files directly.
settings.page.game.subtitle: Global launch defaults used when an instance has no explicit override.
settings.page.game.gap.memoryPolicy.reas: The automatic allocation algorithm and migration rules (D-03) are not implemented in the launch service; only a fixed value is offered.
settings.page.game.gap.fullscreen.title: Fullscreen by default
settings.page.game.gap.fullscreen.reason: Launch arguments and window mode do not support a fullscreen default yet.
settings.page.downloads.subtitle: Global download policy and concurrency; search, queues and installation still live in the download center.
settings.page.downloads.gap.retry.title: Automatic retry and maximum attempts
settings.page.downloads.gap.retry.reason: The download service currently makes up to three attempts per URL; the attempt count is not exposed as configuration yet.
Download and install stages are not separated in every flow, so no ineffective option is shown.
settings.page.downloads.gap.limit.title: Download speed limit
settings.page.downloads.gap.limit.reason: The key exists, but the download engine does not throttle yet; no editable control is shown before it is connected.
settings.page.network.subtitle: Global proxy configuration; source strategy is on the Downloads page and accounts or in-game networking are out of scope.
settings.page.network.gap.endpoint.title: Proxy protocol / host / port and protected credentials
settings.page.network.gap.endpoint.reaso: The structured endpoint, credential protection and old-value migration from D-04 are not implemented; only a single proxy address is kept for now.
settings.page.network.gap.test.title: Test connection
settings.page.network.gap.test.reason: The network service does not provide a diagnosable proxy connectivity test yet.
settings.page.network.gap.default.title: Default proxy mode for new installations
settings.page.network.gap.default.reason: The D-02 installation-generation signal is not reliable and default migration is not implemented; new installations still use system.

Starting Minecraft requires accepting the Minecraft End User License Agreement (EULA).

Read it here: https://aka.ms/minecraftEULA

export.risk.worlds: World saves may contain build locations, coordinates, player data and private places on the map.
export.risk.screenshots: Screenshots may contain player names, chat content, server information and other personal information.
export.risk.schematics: Schematic files may contain build locations, coordinates and private places on the map.
export.risk.logs: Logs may contain user names, server addresses, local file paths, launch arguments and stack traces.

export.permanentExclusionNote: Login state, account authentication data, access tokens, refresh tokens, API keys, private keys and equivalent secrets are never included in any export, regardless of the selected method.
